```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("fig.UHS.sites")
if (!exists("TR.target") || !length(TR.target)) TR.target <- TR.MDE
Vs30.target <- .resolveValueTarget(Vref.gmdp, "Vs30.target", "UHS.sites.qmd")
p.target <- "mean"
fill.target <- FALSE
Sa.log <- TRUE
Sites.caption <- paste(siteID.target, collapse = ", ")
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  UHSTable,
  "UHS.sites.qmd",
  base = TRUE,
  target = Target,
  siteID = siteID.target
)
root <- here::here()
```
